t2.title: Consumerism harming society
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Is consumerism harming society?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Consumerism drives modern economies but raises serious concerns. I believe excessive consumption is indeed harming society and the planet.

Firstly, consumerism damages the environment. Manufacturing products requires resources and creates pollution. Fast fashion and planned obsolescence generate mountains of waste that overwhelm landfills and pollute oceans.

Secondly, constant buying doesn't bring lasting happiness. Research shows material possessions provide temporary satisfaction. The pursuit of "more" creates anxiety and financial stress, particularly among young people influenced by advertising.

However, consumer spending supports jobs and innovation. Without demand, economies would stagnate. Additionally, buying quality products that last can be sustainable.

Nevertheless, the balance has shifted too far. Mindful consumption – buying less but better – offers a solution. Supporting ethical brands and secondhand markets reduces harm.

Furthermore, valuing experiences over possessions promotes wellbeing without environmental cost.

In conclusion, while some consumption is necessary, society should shift toward sustainable consumption patterns that prioritize quality, necessity, and environmental responsibility.

Dear SurpriseBox Team,
Thank you for the monthly box. I think it's a good idea, but I have some suggestions. The products are usually okay, but sometimes they aren't very useful. I think the value for money could be better. Sometimes I don't think the items are worth the price.

t2.sampleB2: Are We Buying Our Way to Unhappiness? Walk into any shopping centre and you are bombarded with adverts urging you to buy more and never settle for what you already own. But is all this spending doing us harm? In my view, consumerism is quietly taking its toll on both people and the planet. To begin with, the constant pressure to own the latest gadget or outfit fuels serious anxiety. Many young people fall into debt just to keep up with the crowd, and the buzz of a new purchase rarely lasts long. Instead of feeling content, we soon find ourselves eyeing up the next item on the shelf. On top of that, our shopping habits are wrecking the environment. Fast fashion and throwaway products pile up in landfills, while factories pump out pollution to meet endless demand. The true cost of cheap goods rarely shows on the price tag. Of course, spending does keep economies ticking over and creates jobs. Nobody is suggesting we stop buying altogether. Even so, the answer lies in shopping more mindfully – buying less, choosing quality and backing ethical brands. If we learn to value experiences over things, we can enjoy life without costing the earth.
t2.uzSample:
Iste'molchilik zamonaviy iqtisodiyotlarni harakatga keltiradi, lekin jiddiy xavotirlarni uyg'otadi. Menimcha, haddan tashqari iste'mol jamiyatga va sayyoraga zarar yetkazmoqda.

Birinchidan, iste'molchilik atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazadi. Mahsulotlarni ishlab chiqarish resurslarni talab qiladi va ifloslanishni keltirib chiqaradi. Tez moda va rejalashtirilgan eskirish poligonlarni to'ldiradigan va okeanlarni ifloslantiradigan tonnalab chiqindilarni hosil qiladi.

Ikkinchidan, doimiy xarid qilish uzoq muddatli baxt keltirmaydi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, moddiy boyliklar vaqtinchalik qoniqishni ta'minlaydi. "Ko'proq"ga intilish, ayniqsa reklama ta'sirida bo'lgan yoshlar orasida tashvish va moliyaviy stressni yaratadi.

Biroq, iste'mol xarajatlari ish o'rinlarini va innovatsiyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Talabsiz iqtisodiyot turg'unlashishi mumkin edi. Bundan tashqari, uzoq muddat xizmat qiladigan sifatli mahsulotlarni sotib olish barqaror bo'lishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, muvozanat juda uzoqqa siljidi. Ehtiyotkorlik bilan iste'mol qilish – kamroq, lekin yaxshiroq sotib olish – yechim taklif etadi. Etik brendlarni va ikkinchi qo'l bozorlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash zararni kamaytiradi.

Bundan tashqari, mulkka nisbatan tajribaga ustunlik berish atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazmasdan farovonlikni oshiradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ba'zi iste'mol zarur bo'lsa-da, jamiyat sifat, zarurat va atrof-muhit uchun mas'uliyatni ustuvor qo'yadigan barqaror iste'mol usullariga o'tishi kerak.

Hurmatli SurpriseBox jamoasi,
Oylik qutingiz uchun rahmat. Menimcha, bu yaxshi g'oya, lekin menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Mahsulotlar odatda yaxshi, lekin ba'zida ular unchalik foydali emas. Menimcha, pulga nisbatan qiymat yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zan narsalar narxga arziydi deb o'ylamayman.
Qutini ochish qiziqarli, lekin uni yaxshilash mumkin. Ehtimol, siz mahsulotlarni nima uchun tanlaganingizni tushuntiruvchi kichik kartochka qo'shishingiz mumkin.
Kelgusi qutilar uchun men ko'proq xobbi bilan bog'liq mahsulotlarni, masalan, rasm chizish materiallari yoki kitoblarni ko'rishni xohlardim. Shuningdek, har oyda mavzu bo'lishi qiziqarli bo'lishi mumkin, masalan, "sayohat" mavzusi yoki "pazandachilik" mavzusi.
Umuman olganda, menga xizmat yoqadi, lekin menimcha, yaxshilanish uchun joy bor.

Akmal Karimov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli SurpriseBox jamoasi,
Men yaqinda SurpriseBox Monthly bilan bog‘liq tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Yangi mahsulotlarni kashf qilish g‘oyasini qadrlasam-da, mahsulot tanlovi, pulga arziydiganligi va umumiy qutini ochish tajribasi bo‘yicha ba’zi takliflarim bor.
Mahsulot tanlovi nuqtai nazaridan, buyumlar sifati va mening manfaatlarimga mosligi jihatidan biroz nomuvofiq ekanligini aniqladim. Ajablanish elementi muhimligini tushunsam-da, obuna bo‘lish paytida qisqa so‘rov o‘tkazish qutini individual xohishlarga moslashtirishga yordam berishi mumkin. Men, shuningdek, pulga arziydiganligiga shubha qilaman; bir necha holatlarda buyumlarning umumiy chakana narxi obuna narxiga nisbatan nomutanosib darajada past bo‘lib tuyuldi.
Qutini ochish tajribasi odatda yoqimli, ammo menimcha, uni yanada batafsil mahsulot ma’lumotlari bilan yaxshilash mumkin. Ishlab chiqaruvchilar va har bir buyumning mo‘ljallangan maqsadlari haqida ma’lumot beruvchi kichik buklet yoki onlayn resurs qimmatli qo‘shimcha bo‘ladi. Kelajakdagi mavzularga kelsak, men, ayniqsa, barqaror hayot, hunarmandchilik yoki xalqaro oshxonaga qaratilgan qutilarga qiziqaman. Ushbu mavzular obunachilarni noyob va axloqiy manbalardan olingan mahsulotlar bilan tanishtirish imkoniyatini beradi.
Fikr-mulohazalarimni ko‘rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. Umid qilamanki, bu takliflar SurpriseBox Monthly-ning umumiy sifati va jozibasini oshirishga yordam beradi.
Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Karimov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the subscription box service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SurpriseBox Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your subscription service. I am thoroughly enjoying my monthly boxes. The product curation is excellent, introducing me to brands I'd never have discovered alone. The unboxing experience is genuinely exciting, and the value exceeds the subscription cost. However, I have some suggestions. Some items don't match my personal preferences, which feels wasteful. Additionally, the packaging uses too much plastic. I would appreciate a preference quiz to customize boxes better. Themed boxes for holidays would be exciting. Also, using eco-friendly packaging would align with environmental values. Overall, SurpriseBox brings joy to my monthly routine. Yours sincerely, Akmal Karimov
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SurpriseBox,


I like box. It is good. I like the toys. The toys are fun. More toys please. Thank you.


Bye,


Akmal Karimov
t12.sampleA2:
Hello SurpriseBox Team,


Thank you for the box every month. I like some things, but not all things. The box is good, and the things are a surprise. But sometimes I don't like the things in the box. I like the toys and the food. I don't like the clothes because they are too big.


I think you should put more toys in the box. And maybe some candy. Thank you for the box.


Bye,


Akmal Karimov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SurpriseBox Team,


Thank you for your email. I am writing to you about the SurpriseBox I get every month. I think the idea is very good, and it is always exciting to see what is inside. The value for money is usually good, but sometimes I don't like the products very much.


For example, last month's box had a book, and I don't like reading very much. Also, the box had a lot of plastic packaging, which I think is bad for the environment. I think you could use less plastic.


I would like to see more boxes with themes, like a 'cooking' box or a 'travel' box. In my opinion, this would make the boxes more interesting. Thank you for listening to my feedback.


Sincerely,


Akmal Karimov
t12.sampleB2: Dear SurpriseBox Team, Thank you for getting in touch to ask about my experience with your subscription service. On the whole, I have been thoroughly impressed. The product selection is varied and thoughtful, and I have come across several brands I would never have found on my own. The unboxing itself is genuinely exciting, and I feel the boxes offer good value for money. That said, there is room for improvement. A short preference survey when subscribers sign up would help you tailor each box more closely to individual tastes. I would also urge you to cut down on plastic packaging and switch to eco-friendly alternatives. Finally, seasonal themed boxes for holidays would be a lovely touch. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova

Birinchidan, kutilmaganlik jozibadorlikning bir qismi bo'lsa-da, ba'zi qutilarda mening manfaatlarimga mutlaqo aloqasi bo'lmagan narsalar bor edi. Shuningdek, kichik, mustaqil bizneslar bilan hamkorlik o'zaro manfaatli bo'lishi mumkin. Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur.


Hurmat bilan,
